_source: read off the live SROT board over MAVLink, /dev/ttyUSB0 @115200 from mongla.local, 2026-09-23
_coverage: EVERY name in bench_api.cpp's s_bench_params -- 37 of 37, none missing. An earlier version of this file carried 20, which left roll/pitch I/D/FF/IMAX, both ANG_*_P, DEPTH_* and the TRIM/THR_TRIM group silently at config.h defaults. That is the same class of divergence as PILOT_YAW_RATE and it is now closed by test_the_capture_covers_every_bench_parameter.
_why: config.h defaults are NOT what this vehicle runs. PILOT_YAW_RATE ships at 45.0 and reads back 160.0 -- a 3.556x error on every yaw torque computed from the defaults.
_gain_note: JS_GAIN_DEFAULT is the power-on value only; the LIVE gain is runtime and steppable 0.10..1.00 by joystick button. sp_yaw = (r/1000)*gain, mav_commands.cpp:736. At GAIN 1.0 a host yaw_pct of 5.0 is sp_yaw 0.05; at 0.5 it is 0.025 and every threshold doubles.
_battery_note: MOT_BAT_V_MAX is 16.8 (non-zero), so thrust-vs-voltage compensation is CONFIGURED on this board -- mixer.cpp:118. Whether it is ACTIVE depends on batteryScale(), which returns 0 until the board has seen a pack voltage. The bench does not call set_battery, so bench results are UNCOMPENSATED unless a scenario sets it, and that matches the mixer_ladder capture, which was taken with no thruster pack. ANY number quoted for the vehicle in water must state the pack voltage it was computed at.

_not_a_param._note: real board params, but nothing the bench links reads them -- FRAME_REVERSE and the motor directions are applied by control_bench.drive(), and MOVE_CRUISE_MAX lives in movement.cpp which the bench does not link.
